notes:
- Media Library search now understands several words (all must match), | or OR for either, "quotes" for exact words, -word to exclude, and artist:, album:, title: or genre: to search one field.
- "Remove all" in the Media Library now works on every matching track and reports only what was actually removed.
- Playlists in the Media Library can be sorted by name, number of tracks or origin.
- Several playlists can now be ticked and deleted in one step.
- Playlists from a sync program can now be deleted and edited, so a library that is no longer synced can be tidied on the server.
- MusicPort adds A-Z navigation for albums.
